welcome.title: Desk work
welcome.text: Sit at your desk with your keyboard and mouse. Work as you normally do: the cameras record your hands, nothing you type or click is saved.|Press the button on the right side of the headset to start each step. Pressed while recording, it pauses.

done.title: All done
done.text: Thank you! This recording session will close. Continue in the application.|Review your recordings in the Hand recorder window.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.text: What was recorded so far is saved. Review it in the Hand recorder window.

sections.title: Hand size
sections.intro: First, your hand size: both hands up about 40 cm out, still.

prompts.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Palms toward you

switch.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Backs toward you

sections.title: Keyboard and mouse
sections.intro: Now your desk. Look down at your hands while you work, as you would without the headset.

prompts.text: Type on your keyboard the way you normally do, both hands.|Any text is fine: it isn't saved.
Use your mouse with the hand you normally use: move it, click, scroll.|Leave the other hand where it would rest.
Switch when the picture changes: type with both hands,|or go to the mouse and use it.
Rest both hands on the desk or the keyboard without typing,|as when you stop to read.

switch.text: Now hold both hands just above the keys,|about to type, not touching.

sections.title: Look up, reach out
sections.intro: Windows will appear in front of you, as on a desk. Keep working with the keyboard and mouse, and do what each one asks: they don't move or click, the cameras record your hands.

prompts.text: Keep typing or using the mouse. When the window lights up, look up at it,|keep your hands working, then look back down at them.

acts.say: Eyes on your hands, keep working
Look up at the lit window, hands still working

prompts.text: Right hand on the mouse (or the keyboard). Reach up and do what the lit button asks,|then put the hand straight back.

says.tap: Tap it, then back to the mouse
says.poke: Poke it, then back to the mouse
says.nogo: Reach, stop 1 cm short, then back

prompts.text: Left hand on the keyboard. Reach up and do what the lit button asks,|then put the hand straight back.

says.tap: Tap it, then back to the keys
says.poke: Poke it, then back to the keys
says.nogo: Reach, stop 1 cm short, then back

prompts.text: Hands stay at the desk. Look at the lit button and pinch with the hand on the mouse or keyboard,|without lifting it, then carry on working.

says.tap: Look at it, pinch from the desk
